editorNote: Demo edition — these sample records illustrate an arXiv RSS research desk. They are intentionally labeled examples, not a live literature review.

stories.headline: Demo sample: a paper enters the review queue
stories.summary: This sample story represents a research-paper entry with a direct source link. It makes the research source visible in the product without presenting an invented paper as real.
stories.whyItMatters: A paper feed gives readers a separate lane for research signals and avoids mixing preprints with product announcements.
